note: Skeleton SSOT for the mesh rig (D73), AnimatedDrawings char_cfg shape: skeleton[{name, loc, parent}], width, height. loc is in assets/human/mask.png pixel space (the same space as mesh.json); the figure is part00, region [31,30,621,952).

root.note: crotch, midpoint of the two leg tops; rig has no root pivot (rig root is the torso)

torso.note: rig torso pivot (148,34) inside part01 + template match of part01 in part00 at (169,149), normSSD 0.53

neck.note: top of the collar; rig neck part matched the wrong place (normSSD 0.77, found a boot cuff)

head.note: rig head pivot (48,100) inside part11 + template match of part11 in part00 at (268,46), normSSD 0.55; the head base / chin joint

shoulderL.note: outer shoulder bump of the poncho; the joint itself is hidden under the cloth, and rig armL_up pivot is the top of a separate sleeve cutout that part00 does not contain

elbowL.note: where the arm leaves the poncho hem; the upper arm is hidden under the cloth, rig has an elbow pivot but the part00 arm is one straight spread limb

wristL.note: where the arm meets the palm; rig handL pivot is the top of the separate hand cutout (template match normSSD 1.03, unusable)

shoulderR.note: mirror of shoulderL about the collar

elbowR.note: where the arm leaves the poncho hem

wristR.note: where the arm meets the palm (handR template match normSSD 1.07, unusable)

hipL.note: top of the image-left leg under the poncho tip; rig legL pivot is the top of a separate leg cutout (match normSSD 0.66)

kneeL.note: mid-leg; the rig has no knee (leg is one part, boot a second part)

ankleL.note: cuff of the image-left boot; rig bootL pivot is the top of a separate boot cutout (match normSSD 0.50)

hipR.note: top of the image-right leg; rig legR pivot (match normSSD 0.51)

kneeR.note: mid-leg; the rig has no knee

ankleR.note: cuff of the image-right boot; rig bootR pivot (match normSSD 0.50)

ponchoPoint.note: lowest point of the poncho; a cloth anchor, never posed, so the poncho does not follow the arms (not an anatomical joint; not in the rig)

registration.note: mask space -> HumanPuppet canvas space (the 600 px wide rig canvas HumanPuppet draws in): canvas = scale * (p - originMask) + originCanvas. Scale matches the assembled puppet's footprint height (986 px, y 20..1006 from rig.json parts); x aligns the head joint with rig.json head pivot x 348. The figure is the part00 drawing (arms spread, legs apart), not the assembled puppet's arms-down rest, so the footprints agree in height, top and head x, not in every limb.
